description: This file defines the SignUpViewModel class, which manages the UI state and validation logic for a sign-up screen in a Kotlin Android application. It handles input validation, error messaging, and navigation triggers.

classes.name: SignUpViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing sign-up form validation, error states, and navigation events.

methods.name: onSignUpClicked
methods.description: Validates email, password, and confirm password inputs, updates error messages, and triggers navigation if input is valid.

methods.name: onNavigatedToDashboard
methods.description: Resets the navigation trigger after navigation has occurred.
